ENGINE MECHANICAL (2JZ-GTE)  -  TIMING BELT

S00394

8.    SET NO.1 CYLINDER TO TDC/COMPRESSION
(a)   Turn the crankshaft pulley, and align its groove with timing
mark "0" of the No.1 timing belt cover.
NOTICE:
Always turn the crankshaft clockwise.

P02273

(b)   Check that the timing marks of the camshaft timing pul-
leys are aligned with the timing marks of the No.4 timing
belt cover.
If not, turn the crankshaft 1 revolution (360˚).

A02562

9.    REMOVE TIMING BELT FROM CAMSHAFT TIMING
PULLEYS
HINT:
(Re-using  timing belt):
Place matchmarks on the timing belt and camshaft timing pul-
leys as shown in the illustration.

P11528

(a)   Alternately loosen the 2 bolts, and remove them, the ten-
sioner and dust boot.

A02563

(b)   Disconnect the timing belt from the camshaft timing pul-
leys.
